"""Run actual bounded helper tests/help/lint and a native read-only inspect smoke check."""

import os
import subprocess

from common import BASE, PACKAGE, PY, ROOT, TARGET_SHA, bind, now, read, write

out = PACKAGE / "helper-validation"
out.mkdir()
commands = [("guards", [PY, "-B", str(PACKAGE / "test_guards.py")])]
for name in [
    "prepare_archive.py",
    "apply_archive.py",
    "assemble_review.py",
    "run_native.py",
    "archive_completion.py",
    "bind_final_files.py",
    "seal_completion.py",
    "inspect_with_inputs.py",
]:
    commands.append((name + "-help", [PY, "-B", str(PACKAGE / name), "--help"]))
write(out / "inspect-inputs.json", ["schema/record_review.yaml", "scripts/record_review.py"])
commands.append(
    (
        "native-inspect-smoke",
        [
            PY,
            "-B",
            str(PACKAGE / "inspect_with_inputs.py"),
            "--input-list",
            str(out / "inspect-inputs.json"),
            "--targets",
            str(PACKAGE / "targets.yaml"),
        ],
    )
)
commands.append(("lint", [PY, "-B", "-m", "ruff", "check", str(PACKAGE), "--no-cache"]))
env = {
    **os.environ,
    "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
    "UV_NO_SYNC": "1",
    "PYTHONPATH": str(ROOT / "src") + os.pathsep + str(ROOT),
}
receipts = []
for label, command in commands:
    started = now()
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, capture_output=True)
    streams = {}
    for name in ["stdout", "stderr"]:
        path = out / (label + "." + name)
        path.write_bytes(getattr(result, name))
        streams[name] = bind(path)
    receipts.append(
        {
            "name": label,
            "command": command,
            "cwd": str(ROOT),
            "started_at": started,
            "finished_at": now(),
            "exit_code": result.returncode,
            **streams,
        }
    )
    print(label, result.returncode, flush=True)
    if result.returncode:
        break
inspection = (
    read(out / "native-inspect-smoke.stdout")
    if (out / "native-inspect-smoke.stdout").exists()
    else None
)
if inspection is not None:
    assert inspection["source"]["git_revision"] == BASE
    assert (
        next(
            x
            for x in inspection["source"]["inputs"]
            if x["path"] == "data/pathways/l-lyxose-degradation.yaml"
        )["sha256"]
        == TARGET_SHA
    )
write(
    PACKAGE / "helper-validation.json",
    {
        "at": now(),
        "receipts": receipts,
        "all_passed": len(receipts) == len(commands) and all(x["exit_code"] == 0 for x in receipts),
        "scope": 'Ten bounded guard tests, eight inert CLI help calls, ac'
            'tual native inspect of target plus two rubric files, ful'
            'l lint of helper package. No native save/history, mainta'
            'ined mutation or full gate claim.',
        "maintained_mutations": False,
    },
)
raise SystemExit(
    0 if len(receipts) == len(commands) and all(x["exit_code"] == 0 for x in receipts) else 1
)
